AL destroying the Language Movement spirit
2022-02-22T00:00:00+06:00 | UNB, Dhaka
https://www.thedailystar.net/news/bangladesh/politics/news/al-destroying-the-language-movement-spirit-2967666

BNP yesterday accused the Awami League government of destroying the spirit of the Language Movement.

"This is our bad luck that now there's a government in power which has distorted the spirit of Amar Ekushey. It has snatched the right to vote and freedom of speech," said BNP secretary general Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir.

Talking to reporters after paying homage to language martyrs by placing wreaths at the altar of Central Shaheed Minar, he also said the current government is crippling the country's economy.
